description: Canonical structure for the machine-readable Client ROS data file produced by the Client ROS skill. The Client ROS deliverable is the host-facing recording-day script with placeholders filled in for a specific firm. This JSON captures every populated value (firm, attorney, host, episode metadata, segments, questions, durations, entity checklist) so downstream skills (client-guide, clip-table, show-notes) can read structured input rather than parsing the rendered .md / Google Doc. If a field is added/renamed/reordered, edit this schema first, then update the skill prose. Bump `version` and append to `version_history` on every change.

version_history.change: Initial schema. Captures: show_name, firm, attorney, host, episode metadata, practice_area, scope, location, episode_goal, pre_show_checks, segments (with intro_prompt + questions), post_show_wrapup, closing, entity_checklist, metadata (provenance).

Aligned scope/location descriptions to the canonical three-field geo model (Targeting strategy / Optimization scope (show anchor) / Episode geo target). `location` sharpened from 'jurisdictional anchor' to the episode's Episode geo target city (may differ from the show anchor); `scope` note clarifies it is the per-episode geo breadth, not the show anchor. No field added/renamed/reordered. Gabe directive 2026-07-10, Whalen scoping.

show_name.description: Podcast name in title case (e.g., 'Car Accident Attorney w. Robert May'). Usually `{Firm} Podcast` but can deviate per the firm's brand. Matches `{{PODCAST_NAME}}` placeholder.

firm.description: Full firm name as it appears in Drive (e.g., 'The May Firm', 'Spaulding Injury Law', 'Sutliff & Stout'). Matches `{{FIRM_NAME}}` placeholder. Treated as a named entity - underlined every time it appears in the body.

attorney.description: The attorney being interviewed. Treated as a named entity - underlined every time the name appears.

full_name.description: Full attorney name (e.g., 'Robert May', 'Theodore "Ted" A. Spaulding'). Matches `{{ATTORNEY_NAME}}` placeholder.

first_name.description: First name only (e.g., 'Robert', 'Ted'). Matches `{{ATTORNEY_FIRST_NAME}}` placeholder. Used in the intro greet line.

name.description: Host first name as appears on-mic (e.g., 'Kara', 'Abby Arnold'). Matches `{{HOST_NAME}}` placeholder.

episode_topic.description: Episode title verbatim (e.g., 'How to File a Car Accident Claim in California'). The H1 line in the body.

practice_area.description: Practice area lowercase plural (e.g., 'car accidents', 'truck accidents'). Matches `{{PRACTICE_AREA}}` placeholder.

scope.description: Scope this Client ROS was populated at - the per-episode geo breadth, NOT the show anchor. Encoded in the firm episode-folder name (E{N} - {Episode} - {Location}). Under the canonical three-field geo model this is set by the Episode geo target, which for a multi-location firm can differ from the show's Optimization scope (show anchor).

location.required: conditional - required when scope is Location or Extension
location.description: The episode's Episode geo target - the specific city THIS episode is built to rank for, NOT necessarily the show's Optimization scope (show anchor). Fills the `{{CITY}}` / `{{STATE}}` placeholders. Per the canonical three-field geo model (Targeting strategy / Optimization scope (show anchor) / Episode geo target), a multi-location statewide firm anchors the show broad while each episode targets a different city here.

city.description: The Episode geo target city (e.g., 'Long Beach', 'Atlanta') - the city THIS episode is built to rank for, not necessarily the show anchor. Required if the Episode geo target is city-level (`CA - Long Beach`). Empty only when the Episode geo target is state-level.

state.description: State full name (e.g., 'California', 'Georgia'). Convert state code to full name at populate time.

county.description: County name (e.g., 'Fulton County', 'Los Angeles County'). Optional context.

drive_folder_label.description: State-prefixed jurisdictional folder name as it appears in Drive (e.g., 'CA', 'CA - Long Beach', 'CA - Los Angeles County'). Format defined in the canonical Podcast Drive doc.

episode_number.description: Episode identifier (e.g., '2', 'B1' for bonus episodes). Just the N in `E{N}` for standard episodes; `B{N}` for bonus / SEO episodes. Matches `{{EPISODE_NUMBER}}` placeholder.

duration_min.description: Estimated total duration in minutes (e.g., 55 for full episode, 30 for extension, 16 for bonus). Sum of segment durations + intro + outro.

recording_date.description: Recording date in `MM-DD-YYYY` format (e.g., '04-14-2026'). Matches `{{RECORDING_DATE}}` placeholder. May be 'TBD' for bonus / SEO episodes that haven't been scheduled.

phone_number.description: Firm phone in `(XXX) XXX-XXXX` format. Matches `{{PHONE_NUMBER}}` placeholder. Surfaces in the closing CTA, bolded.

website.description: Firm website with `https://` prefix (e.g., 'https://mayfirm.com/'). Matches `{{WEBSITE}}` placeholder. Surfaces in Producer Notes + closing CTA, bolded.

template_version.description: Upstream ROS Template version this Client ROS was populated from (e.g., '2.0', '1.0'). Carried in the metadata header for audit.

episode_goal.description: What this specific episode is trying to accomplish for this firm. Drives populate-time selection rules per Best Practices > Research is the palette.

producer_notes.description: Producer-facing context block at the top of the Client ROS body (after the metadata header, before the Introduction).

jurisdiction.description: Rich jurisdictional paragraph - statutes, comparative negligence framework, statute of limitations, courts, key agencies. Carries pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` markers around named entities.

about_attorney.description: One-sentence about-the-attorney line (attorney name + firm name underlined). Pattern: `[Attorney]{.underline} is a personal injury attorney at [Firm]{.underline} in {City}, {State}.`

production_flags.description: Optional production / compliance flags (e.g., phone number conflicts, brand exclusions, do-not-cite language). Empty array if none.

introduction.description: Three-paragraph host introduction with transition line. No attorney response in the intro.

paragraphs.description: Exactly three `*[Co-Host]*` paragraphs: welcome-back -> greet attorney -> topic frame. Carries pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` markers.

transition_line.description: The transition cue line that closes the intro.

co_host_notes.description: Optional italic producer note for the host on intro tone / framing.

pre_show_checks.description: Optional pre-show production checks (mic levels, recording device, attorney readiness). Most Client ROS files don't include this inline - it's typically a separate producer checklist. If included, render as a bulleted list above the Introduction.

segments.description: Episode segments. Full episodes: 4-5 segments. Extension episodes: 1-2 segments. Bonus / SEO episodes: 1 segment.

name.description: Segment title (e.g., 'At the Scene - What to Do Right Now', 'The Atlanta Truck Accident Liability Chain'). Renders as `## S{N}: {name} (~{duration} minutes)` H2.

intro_prompt.description: Optional opening line / hook for the segment - only used in some templates. Most segments dive straight into Q1.

questions.description: Questions in this segment. Each populated with firm / attorney / city / state / statutes specifics.

q_id.description: Continuous question identifier across the whole episode (e.g., 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q15'). Numbering does not reset per segment.

q_text.description: The bold framing question verbatim (e.g., 'What should someone do immediately after a car accident in California to protect their claim?'). Renders bold, with city / state populated inline.

co_host_setup.description: ONE sentence the co-host says before the bold framing question. Describes the listener's situation. Never explains how things work.

attorney_bullets.description: Attorney response bullets in `**Label:** detail` format. Carry pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` markers around named entities (statutes, agencies, courts, highways, hospitals). 3-6 bullets per question is typical.

segment_wrap.description: Optional single `*[Co-Host]*` paragraph at end of segment that bridges to the next segment. The ONLY co-host text between questions inside a segment - all other co-host appearances are at the start of a Q block.

closing.description: Closing and Call to Action block. Hard-gated placeholder surface.

final_takeaway_question.description: The bold framing question that launches the attorney's final takeaway moment (e.g., 'For someone listening right now who has just been in a car accident in California - what is the one thing you want them to remember?').

attorney_takeaway_bullets.description: Final attorney bullets - one strong piece of advice apiece in `**Label:** detail` format.

cta_line.description: The closing CTA paragraph that surfaces populated phone, website, firm name, and podcast name (all bold). Hard-gated quality check: phone + website both bold.

post_show_wrapup.description: Optional post-show producer wrap-up checklist (next steps, what attorney can expect, follow-up timeline). Most Client ROS files don't include this inline - it lives in the upstream ROS Template Appendix / Client Guide instead.

entity_checklist.description: Recording-time tally sheet. Sits AFTER `*End of Run of Show*` as the canonical 4-column table. Row count target: 10-15 entities for Location/City scope; 6-10 for Topic Only; 12-18 for state-level anchor episodes.

entity.description: Named entity wrapped in pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` (e.g., '[Houston Police Department (HPD)]{.underline}'). Drawn from the matching-scope entity map. Tier 1 + Tier 2 always; Tier 3 only when entity appears in 2+ questions.

questions.description: Comma-separated Q numbers where the attorney bullets reference this entity (e.g., ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q4', 'Q5']).

target_mentions.description: Range string per the heuristic (1-2 questions -> '2-3'; 3-4 questions -> '3-5'; 5-6 questions -> '5-7'; 7-9 questions -> '7-10'; 10+ questions -> '12-15').

actual_mentions.description: Blank at populate time. Producer fills in during recording review (post-record, pre-publish) to verify the attorney hit the targets.

metadata.description: Provenance and run-level metadata. Internal-only; useful for audit.

version.description: Schema version used to produce this file (mirrors version field at top of this schema doc).

upstream_template_path.description: Drive path of the ROS Template that was populated - lives in the firm's episode `01 Strategy/` folder (e.g., '{Firm} Podcast/Episodes/E2 - How to File a Car Accident Claim - CA Long Beach/01 Strategy/ROS Template - E2 - How to File a Car Accident Claim - CA Long Beach.md').

placeholders_populated.description: Always 12. Hard quality gate - if less than 12 populated with real values, the run did not pass.

placeholders_remaining.description: Count of `{{...}}` tokens left in the body. Hard quality gate: must be 0.

legacy_u_tag_count.description: Count of legacy HTML `<u>...</u>` tags in the body. Hard quality gate: must be 0 (all converted to pandoc `[...]{.underline}` at populate time).

references_status.description: Whether `references/examples/` had calibration anchors at run time.
